name: tree-view
purpose: Hierarchical list following the WAI-ARIA APG tree pattern: expand and collapse, single or multiple selection, checkboxes with tri-state parents, lazy children loaded through an async hook with loading and error states, type-ahead, Home/End and * to expand siblings, drag-and-drop reordering and reparenting with a keyboard alternative (Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V, Alt+Up / Alt+Down), inline rename in a text input, icons per node, and a filter that keeps the paths to matches visible. Visible nodes are virtualized on the shared windowing engine, so trees with 10,000+ visible nodes stay fast.
whenToUse: Folders and documents, organization units, categories, or any data with parent-child relationships.
Navigation through a deep hierarchy where users expand only what they need.
Picking several items of a hierarchy with tri-state checkboxes (permissions, locations).
whenNotToUse: Flat lists: use Virtual List, Select, or Multi Select.
Site navigation with a few levels: use Sidebar or Menu Bar.
Picking one value of a hierarchy in a form: use Tree Select.
Hierarchical data with columns: use Data Grid tree data.
responsive: Fills the inline size of its host; the block size comes from the height option or, with height null, from the host (for example a Splitter pane). Long labels are truncated with an ellipsis; the rendered window follows the viewport size.
rtl: Indentation, the selection bar, and text follow the writing direction; the twisty points to the inline end and is mirrored; Right and Left Arrow swap (Left opens in RTL).
theme: Component tokens tree-view-radius (radius-md), tree-view-border-color (color-border), and tree-view-indent (space-5). Selected nodes use color-selected and color-selected-text plus a start-edge bar; checked boxes use color-primary with a color-on-primary mark; matches are semibold and underlined. Forced colors use Highlight, HighlightText, and GrayText.
security: Labels are rendered as text and renamed labels are read from a text input (no HTML). Filter matches are marked with <mark> elements built from text nodes. Icons are references to registered icons.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. loadChildren is the application's own function; it receives an AbortSignal that aborts when the tree is destroyed or the node is reloaded.

performance.testedScale: 100,000 nodes, 10,000+ visible at once (expand all); at most 500,000 nodes. The filter scans loaded nodes only.

limitations: Rows have one fixed height (by density or itemHeight); labels do not wrap.
The filter and type-ahead see loaded nodes only; lazy children are not searched until loaded.
Only rendered nodes exist in the DOM, so find-in-page and printing see only those.
Touch drags start on the node icon; the keyboard alternative works everywhere.
unsupported: Columns per node (use Data Grid tree data).
antiPatterns: Reusing node ids across the tree: ids must be unique, including lazily loaded children.
Rebuilding nodes on every change: update({ nodes }) resets loaded children, moves, and renames; keep the tree's own state and read tree.nodes.
